name: AdCP 3.2 multiple Signature-Input labels — verifier MUST process exactly one (sig1, content-digest covered)
spec_reference: #adcp-rfc-9421-profile (One signature per request); AdCP 3.2 profile per #content-digest-and-proxy-compatibility and #adcp-rfc-9421-profile binary value encoding
$comment: 3.2-profile counterpart of positive/004-multiple-signature-labels.json. AdCP 3.2 profile: the signature covers content-digest, binary values use RFC 8941 sf-binary (standard padded Base64), and the verifier advertises covers_content_digest='required'. sig1 is a valid signature covering content-digest. sig2 has a different covered-components set, a different nonce, and a zero-byte signature that would not verify. Verifiers MUST process exactly one Signature-Input label (conventionally sig1) and MUST ignore additional labels; attempting to verify sig2 and rejecting is non-conformant. Generated by scripts/generate-request-signing-profile-3.2-vectors.mjs from the test keys in keys.json; do not hand-edit.
